posts.t: Brind'Amour on Nikishin: "I think the offensive stuff, that didn’t surprise us. He’s got a good shot. I don't think that's the part of the game that's going to take a little time being out.
Nikishin on scoring is his first game back: "Not bad, I think. Not bad. When I shot I didn't see if score was me or the guys. I think scoring in the first game is not too bad."
Nikishin with the primary assist. Two-point night in his return.
GOAL: Nikishin. Yes, Alexander Nikishin. He's back. 7-0.

threads.t: Alexander Nikishin scores in his first game of the season as he makes it 7-0
